questions.question: How many isosceles triangles with integer sides are possible such that the sum of two of the sides is 16 cm?
questions.solution:
**Concept used :**

In a triangle,

Sum of two sides is always greater than the third side

Difference of the two sides is always less than the third side

**Calculations :**

Let the sides of the triangle be x cm, x cm and y cm.

Case 1 when x + x = 16 

So, 

|x - x| < y < x + x 

⇒ 0 < y < 2x 

⇒ 0 < y < 16 

So Y can 1, 2, 3,,,,,,,,,,15 

In this case total 15 triangles are possible

Case 2, when x + y = 16 (x and y are not equal to 8)

|x - x| < y < x + x

⇒ 0 < y < 2x 

⇒ 0 < y < 2(16 - y) 

⇒ 0 < y < 32 - 2y 

⇒ 0 < 3y < 32 

⇒ 0 < y < 10.33 

Y can take values from 1 to 10 except 8, so here y can take 9 values

Total number of triangles = 15 + 9 

⇒ 24 

**∴ The correct choice is option 2.**

questions.question: In an examination of 180 marks of a subject, 75% marks are allocated for theory and the rest for project work. Veena scored 60% in theory. What percentage of marks must she score in the project to achieve an overall 62% marks in the subject?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In an examination of 180 marks of a subject, 75% marks are allocated for theory and the rest for project work.

Veena scored 60% in theory.

**Calculations:**

Total marks needed = 62% of 180

⇒ (62/100) × 180 = 111.6

Total theory marks = 75% of 180 = 135

Total practice marks = 25% of 180 = 45

Marks he got in theory = 60% of 135 = 81

Required extra marks to get 62% = 111.6 - 81 = 30.6

Now, 30.6 as percentage of 45 marks 

⇒ (30.6/45)100 = 68%

**∴ The correct choice is option 2.**

questions.question: A sum of money amounts to Rs.28,224 in 2 years and to Rs. 29,635.20 in 3 years when invested on compound interest, compounded annually. What is the sum of money?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

A sum of money amounts to Rs.28,224 in 2 years and to Rs. 29,635.20 in 3 years when invested on compound interest, compounded annually.

**Concept used :**

If the rate of interest is r % compounded annually, then

Total interest for 2 years = r + r + [(r × r)/100] 

**Calculations :**

we know that compound interest in calculate on previous amount not on principle like simple interest 

So interest on Rs 28224 = 29635.20 - 28224 

⇒ 1411.2 

Interest rate = [(1411.2)/28224] × 100 

⇒ 5%

Total interest for 2 years = 5 + 5 + [(5 × 5)/100] = 10.25% 

So, 

Principle + 10.25% of principle = 28224 

⇒ 110.25% of principle = 28224 

⇒ Principle = [(28224)/11025] × 10000

⇒ 25600 

**∴ The correct choice is option 1.**

questions.question: A merchant announces 25% discount on the price of a shirt. If one needs to have a total rebate of Rs. 875 and the price of each shirt is Rs. 250. then how many shirts should the person purchase?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The merchant gives a discount of 25% on each shirt having cost price of Rs 250

**Calculations:**

Discount of each shirt = 25% of 250 = 62.5 rupees

He wants a total of 875 rupees as a discount.

So,

Number of shirts he purchased × discount on each shirt = Total discount

Number of shirts × 62.5 = 875

The number of shirts = 875/62.5 = 14

**∴ The correct choice will be option 3.**

questions.question: A can do a work in 7 (1)/(2) hours and B can do the same work in 10 (1)/(2) hours. If they work together for 3 (1)/(2) hours, then what part of the work will be left out?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A & B can do a work in 7(1/2) & 10(1/2) hours respectively

**Calculations:**

Time of A = 15/2 hours

Time of B = 21/2 hours

Let Total work = 105 units [Multiple of 15 and 21]

A per hour work = 105/(15/2) = 14 units

B per hour work = 105/(21/2) = 10 units

Their total work in 7/2 hours = (24) × (7/2) = 84 units

Work left out = 105 - 84 = 21 units

Fraction work left = 21/105 = 1/5th

**∴ The correct choice is option 1.**

questions.question: If the number 583p2310q2 is divisible by 11, then what is the value of p × q. where p > q?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

For a number to be divisible by 11, the difference of the sum of digits at even & odd places must either be 0 or equal to 11.

**Calculations:**

For 583p2310q2

5 + 3 + 2 + 1 + q = 8 + p + 3 + 0 + 2

⇒ 11 + q = 13 + p

⇒ q - p = 2 ( not possible, p > q given)

Condition 2

⇒ 13 + p - (11 + q) = 11

⇒ 13 + p - 11 - q = 11

⇒ p - q + 2 = 11

⇒ p - q = 9

This condition is only possible when, p = 9 and q = 0, as we can put only single digit numbers

So 

⇒ p × q = 9 × 0 

⇒ 0 

**∴ The correct choice is option 1.**

questions.question: If x³ + y³ = 468 and x + y = 12, then the value of x⁴ + y⁴ will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x³ + y³ = 468

x + y = 12

**Calculations:**

x⁴ + y⁴ = (x² + y²)² - 2x²y² ......(1)

x³ + y³ = (x + y) (x² + y² - xy)

468/12 = (x² + y² - xy) 

39 = (x² + y² - xy) ......(2)

(x+y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

144 = x² + y² + 2xy

x² + y² = 144 - 2xy ......(3)

Putting x² + y² in equ.(2)

 39 = (144 - 2xy - xy)

We get xy = 35 & x² + y² = 74

Now,

x⁴ + y⁴ = (74)² - 2(35)²

⇒ 5476 - 2450

⇒ 3026

**∴ The correct choice is option 4.**
